blocks.prompt: 4. Show that the an equation of parabola with focus at \((a\cos\theta, a\sin\theta)\) and directrix \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta + a = 0\) is \((x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta)^{2} = 4a(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)^{2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh saabit karne wala (proof) sawal hai. Focus aur directrix diye hain, magar \(a\) aur \(\theta\) ki shakal mein, numbers mein nahi.
Tareeqa wohi purana: parabola par point \(P(x, y)\) lo aur \(|PF|^{2} = |PM|^{2}\) likho.
Phir expand karte waqt \(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta = 1\) bar bar kaam aayega.
Kaam chhota karne ke liye do chhote naam rakhenge: \(u = x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta\) aur \(v = x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta\). In ki khaas baat yeh hai ke \(u^{2} + v^{2} = x^{2} + y^{2}\).
Pehle hi bata dein: kitab ke chhape hue jawab mein daayen taraf ek faltu square hai; hum sahi nateeja saabit karenge aur neeche correction denge.
steps:
Diya gaya: focus \(F(a\cos\theta, a\sin\theta)\), directrix \(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta + a = 0\).
Saabit karna: parabola \((x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta)^{2} = 4a(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)\) hai (neeche correction dekhiye).
Tareeqa: \(P(x, y)\) ke liye \(|PF| = |PM|\); \(u = x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta\), \(v = x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta\).

Focus se faasla
\[|PF|^{2} = (x - a\cos\theta)^{2} + (y - a\sin\theta)^{2}\]
\[= x^{2} + y^{2} - 2a(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta) + a^{2}\]
\[= x^{2} + y^{2} - 2au + a^{2}\]
Kyun: dono squares khole; \(a^{2}\cos^{2}\theta + a^{2}\sin^{2}\theta = a^{2}(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta) = a^{2}\). Beech wale do terms ko \(-2a\) common le kar \(u\) bana diya.

Directrix se faasla
\[|PM| = \dfrac{|x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta + a|}{\sqrt{\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta}}\]
\[= |u + a|\]
Kyun: point se line ka faasla; neeche \(\sqrt{1} = 1\) aa gaya, is liye denominator gayab.

Baayen hisse ko saada karein
\[u^{2} + v^{2} = x^{2}(\cos^{2}\theta + \sin^{2}\theta) + y^{2}(\sin^{2}\theta + \cos^{2}\theta)\]
\[= x^{2} + y^{2}\]
Is liye \(x^{2} + y^{2} - u^{2} = v^{2}\), aur (1) ban jati hai
\[v^{2} = 4au\]
Kyun: \(u^{2}\) aur \(v^{2}\) khol kar jama karein to \(2xy\sin\theta\cos\theta\) aur \(-2xy\sin\theta\cos\theta\) aapas mein cancel ho jate hain.
Dhyan dein: yahi chaal (\(u^{2} + v^{2} = x^{2} + y^{2}\)) is sawal ki chaabi hai.

\(u\) aur \(v\) wapas likhein
\[(x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta)^{2} = 4a(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)\]
Kyun: yeh \(v^{2} = 4au\) ki poori shakal hai. Daayen taraf \(u\) ki pehli power hai, square nahi.

Tasdeeq:
\(\theta = 0\): focus \((a, 0)\), directrix \(x = -a\); nateeja \(y^{2} = 4ax\) deta hai, jo sahi standard parabola hai. \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\): focus \((0, a)\), directrix \(y = -a\); nateeja \(x^{2} = 4ay\). Bilkul sahi. (Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab nahi diya gaya.)
Is sawal ka matlab samjhiye: yeh standard parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) hi hai jise origin ke gird angle \(\theta\) se ghuma diya gaya hai. \(u\) aur \(v\) darasal ghumaye hue naye axes ke coordinates hain.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: parabola \((x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta)^{2} = 4a(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)\) hai (daayen taraf square nahi; correction dekhiye).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab nateeja \((x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta)^{2} = 4a(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)^{2}\) chhapti hai, yaani daayen taraf bhi square, aur sawal mein "the an equation" bhi likha hai. Yeh square ghalat hai: \(\theta = 0\) lein to focus \((a, 0)\), directrix \(x = -a\), aur parabola \(y^{2} = 4ax\) hona chahiye, magar chhapa hua nateeja \(y^{2} = 4ax^{2}\) dega. Sahi nateeja, jo upar saabit kiya, yeh hai:
\[(x\sin\theta - y\cos\theta)^{2} = 4a(x\cos\theta + y\sin\theta)\]
